# Device-agnostic tests that can observe which platform they run on, for the
# Intel lane's no-card stage. The rest of the cpu-marked suite is platform
# independent and the CUDA and ROCm lanes already run it: measured on one Intel
# host, those 1150 files (20682 nodes, 7m43s) covered 66% of
# vllm_omni/platforms/xpu/platform.py - all of it import-time registration -
# and 0% of platforms/xpu/utils.py. The 299 files kept here covered 70% and 29%
# respectively, so dropping the remainder costs no XPU behaviour coverage.
#
# Generated by keeping test files that reference the platform layer:
#   current_omni_platform | current_platform | OmniPlatform | device_type
#   | get_device_module | device_control_env_var | torch.xpu | is_xpu
#   | platform_plugin | vllm_omni.platforms | vllm.platforms
# minus the files in xpu-cpu-lane-skip.txt. Regenerate after adding tests that
# touch the platform layer.
